comment: Errors axe-windows reports that are accepted, each with the reason. Prefer fixing the XAML: an entry here is a decision, not a convenience. A rule id and an element name (both exact) must match; "name" may be omitted to accept the rule for every element, which needs an especially good reason; "round" limits an entry to one round of the scenario.

suppressions.reason: Round 12 holds the flyout with a card's merge menu and its submenu open. While a MenuFlyout is open WinUI adds an unnamed Pane the size of the window (the popup layer that positions the menu and catches the light dismiss); it holds the menu and is not a control. The same flyout without a menu (round 3) has no such pane, and the menu's own popups are named and pass every other rule.
